title: Extended profile-led fallback and residual-regression optimization round

acceptance_criteria.AC-WF-1: The workflow validates with zero errors and every executed test, profile, and benchmark has an immutable attempt record.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BASE-1: The accepted Campaign 4 fingerprint and protected organizer inputs are freshly verified and measured before candidate changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CORRECT-1: Every accepted candidate has zero failed elements and no unauthorized fallback, error, OOM, or skip in its required gates.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PERF-1: An accepted candidate improves paired final-matrix geomean by approximately 5 percent or supplies a clear profiler-backed kernel, memory, launch, or held-out-regression benefit, with no affected required case regressing more than 2 percent absent independent waiver.
acceptance_criteria.AC-EVIDENCE-1: Raw timings, error counts, backend counts, profiler events, environment, hashes, and wall time are linked to the exact implementation.
acceptance_criteria.AC-REVIEW-1: The best candidate receives a separate provenance, correctness, timing, boundary, and maintainability review before integration.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RELEASE-1: Only an approved winner is retained and all final, organizer-default, held-out, source-derived, profile, test, documentation, and graph gates are current.
